careers.title: Copy Editing Specialist
careers.eligibility: Degree in English, Journalism, Mass Communication, or equivalent editing experience.
careers.summary: Review and refine content for accuracy, clarity, and consistency across academic and enterprise publications.
responsibilities: Review and refine content for accuracy, clarity, and consistency.
Ensure adherence to publishing standards and client style guides (APA, Chicago, MLA).
Collaborate with content, design, and accessibility teams.
requirements: Strong command of English grammar, syntax, and publishing style guides.
Experience in academic, technical, or corporate editing.
Exceptional attention to detail and ability to meet project deadlines.

careers.title: PPT Accessibility Specialist
careers.eligibility: Proficiency in MS PowerPoint, accessibility guidelines (WCAG, Section 508), and screen reader testing.
careers.summary: Remediate PowerPoint presentations to conform to WCAG 2.2, PDF/UA, and Section 508 standards.
responsibilities: Remediate PowerPoint files to meet accessibility standards (WCAG 2.2, Section 508).
Add meaningful alt text, proper reading order in selection panes, and accessible slide formatting.
Collaborate with clients and internal teams to deliver fully inclusive presentation decks.
requirements: Knowledge of accessibility guidelines (WCAG, Section 508) and assistive technologies (JAWS, NVDA).
Hands-on experience with accessible document remediation and slide design.
Strong communication, problem-solving skills, and empathy for diverse users.

careers.title: Typesetting Specialist
careers.eligibility: Demonstrated experience in InDesign, LaTeX, MathML, or XML publishing production.
careers.summary: Format and design manuscripts, journals, and books for print and multi-format digital publishing.
responsibilities: Format and design manuscripts, journals, and books for digital and print publishing.
Apply consistent styles, layouts, and templates across large volumes of complex content.
Ensure compliance with publishing standards (EPUB 3, JATS/BITS XML, PDF).
requirements: Hands-on experience with typesetting tools (InDesign, LaTeX, MathML, or XML workflows).
Strong eye for typography, layout design, grid structure, and detail.
Ability to manage multiple concurrent titles and meet delivery schedules.

careers.title: AI & Automation Engineer
careers.eligibility: Degree in Computer Science, Data Science, or related field with solid Python programming and automation skills.
careers.summary: Build intelligent workflow pipelines using Python, NLP, and modern LLMs to accelerate content publishing.
responsibilities: Architect AI pipelines that parse, remediate, and validate complex publication manuscripts.
Develop automated quality gates for XML and EPUB conversion pipelines.
Collaborate across cross-disciplinary teams to integrate generative AI safely and accurately.
requirements: Proficiency with Python, API integration, and machine learning/NLP concepts.
Interest in accessibility standards and automated document processing.
Strong problem-solving and proactive debugging abilities.

careers.title: Digital Publishing & XML Intern
careers.eligibility: Students or recent graduates in Computer Science, Literature, or Media Studies looking for hands-on publishing tech experience.
careers.summary: 3-6 months paid internship learning production XML structuring, EPUB standards, and digital editorial pipelines.
responsibilities: Assist production teams with XML tag validation and structuring.
Learn EPUB 3 transformation workflows and quality checks.
Participate in editorial QA rounds for university and enterprise clients.
requirements: Keen interest in digital publishing and semantic structure.
Good English communication skills and enthusiasm to learn new tools.

careers.title: Accessibility Auditing & QA Intern
careers.eligibility: Passionate about digital inclusion, assistive technologies, and Web Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG).
careers.summary: Gain certified training in assistive tech testing (NVDA, JAWS) and PDF/UA remediation.
responsibilities: Learn automated and manual accessibility audit tools.
Draft descriptive alternative text for educational and enterprise diagrams.
Assist specialists in verifying Section 508 and WCAG compliance.
requirements: Strong analytical mindset and willingness to master accessibility tools.

pages.title: Velvora Solutions — Home
pages.summary: Velvora Solutions is a content and technology partner from manuscript to millions of readers. Combining ePublishing, XML, digital accessibility, AI automation, software engineering, and data analytics.

pages.title: Company Overview & Mission
pages.summary: At Velvora Solutions, we believe that content is only as powerful as its accessibility and clarity. Our mission is to bridge editorial craft with digital precision to make publications universally usable.

pages.title: Our Leadership & Team
pages.summary: Guided by Iyshwariya Senthil (Founder & Managing Director, 7+ years of experience in universal design & publishing operations). Our multidisciplinary specialists span editorial, XML architectures, accessibility testing, and cloud development.

pages.title: Careers at Velvora Solutions
pages.summary: Build skills, create impact, and shape the future at Velvora. We offer full-time positions and paid internships with equal opportunity, mentoring, G.R.O.W.T.H. framework, and inclusive workplace culture.

pages.title: ePublishing Services
pages.summary: End-to-end ePublishing from raw manuscript to reflowable and fixed-layout EPUB 3, EPUB 2, interactive eBooks, accessibility tagging, and multi-format delivery for global bookstores (Apple Books, Amazon Kindle, Kobo).

pages.title: XML Services & Conversion
pages.summary: Industry-standard structured XML services: JATS 1.3, BITS 2.1, DocBook, TEI, and custom DTD/Schema conversion. Ensuring long-term preservation, rapid cross-media publishing, and semantic discovery.

pages.title: Digital Accessibility Services
pages.summary: Complete accessibility audits, remediation, and certification. Conforming with WCAG 2.2 AA/AAA, PDF/UA (ISO 14289), Section 508, and EAA. Tested with real assistive technologies (JAWS, NVDA, VoiceOver, TalkBack).

pages.title: Typesetting and Design Services
pages.summary: High-end layout, composition, and book design for trade, academic, and complex multilingual publications. Mastering Adobe InDesign, QuarkXPress, and automated template-driven composition.

pages.title: Math and Equation Typesetting
pages.summary: Specialized STEM composition handling complex mathematical, statistical, and chemical notation using LaTeX, MathML, MathJax, and AMS-TeX, fully compliant with digital accessibility and screen readers.

pages.title: Metadata, Indexing and Taxonomy
pages.summary: Subject indexing, back-of-the-book indexes, hierarchical taxonomy development, DOI/Crossref registration, and ONIX 3.0 metadata feeds to maximize content discoverability and sales telemetry.

pages.title: OCR and Digitization Services
pages.summary: High-accuracy optical character recognition (OCR) and archival digitization for legacy books, brittle paper manuscripts, rare historical documents, and multi-language archives with 99.995% character accuracy.

pages.title: Captioning, Transcription and Audio Description
pages.summary: Accurate closed captioning (CC), subtitles in 20+ languages, verbatim transcripts, and synthesized/human audio description tracks for video and podcast media meeting FCC and WCAG multimedia rules.

pages.title: Accessibility Training and Consulting
pages.summary: Empower your internal editorial and engineering teams with tailored accessibility workshops, VPAT assessments, policy drafting, and executive digital inclusion roadmaps.

pages.title: Industry Solutions
pages.summary: Tailored content and workflow engineering for Academic & Higher Ed, STM Publishers, EdTech Innovators, Global Enterprises, Legal & Regulatory bodies, and Trade Publishers.

pages.title: Contact Velvora Solutions
pages.summary: Get in touch with our team for project quotes, audits, and partnership discussions. Offices in Cuddalore and Chennai Porur. Email: info@velvorasolutions.com, Phone: +91 9500834236.

pages.title: Privacy Policy
pages.summary: Velvora Solutions strictly protects visitor privacy, client project data, and job application resumes. Data is never shared or sold to third parties.

faqs.a: Velvora Solutions is a content and technology partner delivering ePublishing, XML transformation, digital accessibility (WCAG 2.2 & PDF/UA), AI automation pipelines, web development, data analytics, and digital marketing.

Velvora Solutions is founded and led by Iyshwariya Senthil (Founder & Managing Director). She brings 7+ years of executive leadership in digital publishing operations, universal design, and WCAG accessibility standards.
Velvora has offices in Cuddalore (Pathirikuppam, Thiruvantthipuram Post) and Chennai (Porur), Tamil Nadu, India. Office hours are Monday to Saturday, 9:00 AM – 6:30 PM.

faqs.q: How do I apply for jobs or internships at Velvora?
faqs.a: You can view all current active openings and submit your application with a resume (PDF, DOC, DOCX up to 10MB) directly on our official Careers page. Applications are reviewed within 24–48 hours.

faqs.q: What file formats and limits are accepted for job applications?
faqs.a: We accept PDF, DOC, and DOCX formats up to 10MB. Please ensure your contact details and applied position are clearly specified.

faqs.q: What accessibility standards do you comply with?
faqs.a: We test and remediate digital publications, PDFs, PowerPoint decks, and web portals to achieve 100% conformance with WCAG 2.2 (Level AA/AAA), PDF/UA (ISO 14289), Section 508, and the European Accessibility Act (EAA).
